decision.observation: Bomb exploded! Large explosion animation at top-center of room with red enemy head visible in the blast. Character took damage - health reduced from 3 hearts to 2 hearts (one half-heart visible). Some rocks were destroyed. Golden chest is no longer visible at bottom. Enemy appears to have spawned.
decision.hypothesis: Bomb exploded and damaged both environment and character. An enemy has spawned and is in the explosion. Should attack the enemy with tears to defeat it, then explore the room for the chest or other rewards.
decision.memory: Bombs damage the player if too close. Enemy spawned during/after explosion. Lost half a heart from bomb blast. Need to be more careful with bomb placement.
